subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with appropriate preposition.
stimulus: Poverty was hindrance (a) ______ his success. It hindered him (b) ______ going abroad. He did not lose heart. He was hopeful (c) ______ his success. He hit (d) ______ a plan. The plan worked well. He succeeded in the long run. He was thankful (e) ______ Allah.
guide_solution: Prepositions: (a) to (b) from (c) of (d) upon (e) to
